summary.text: Debbie Subera-Wiggin is the Democratic candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives, District 120, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where incumbent Weston Newton (R) is also on the ballot.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an experienced public servant and Beaufort County resident who spent most of her career in public health, food safety and sustainable development in Washington, DC.

paragraphs.text: Subera-Wiggin earned a bachelor's degree from Wichita State University in 1975 and a graduate degree from the Monterey Institute of International Studies in 1986, and her listed career experience is in government.
She advanced from the Democratic primary without appearing on the ballot after the June 9, 2026 primary was canceled.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Subera-Wiggin named investing in public schools and supporting teachers, advocating safe and affordable access to food, housing and healthcare, and protecting the coastal environment as her campaign messages.
She said she is passionate about civil rights, voting rights and due process of the law.
